messages.content: 我最近搬到了舊金山，並計劃前往Rivermist。這兩個地方有多遠？我想在開始這次冒險之前了解一下距離。

We need to estimate distance between two cities. There\'s a function estimate_distance(cityA, cityB). But we need zipcodes? The function expects cityA and cityB as zipcodes. Actually the function signature: estimate_distance(_:{ cityA: string, cityB: string }). It says "The zipcode of the first city." So we need zipcodes. We can use get_zipcode_based_on_city to get zipcodes. So steps: get zipcodes for San Francisco and Rivermist. Then call estimate_distance. Then display result. Probably also display log. Let\'s do that.\n\nWe need to call get_zipcode_based_on_city twice. Then estimate_distance. Then display_log.')
